name: Selected Topics in Computer Graphics and Vision
description:
This lecture presents machine learning algorithms and techniques that are particularly useful for robotics and computer vision applications. The main focus will be on the introduction and algorithmic description of these methods and their application to machine perception tasks such as object detection and recognition. The major topics of this lecture include:

- Regression
- Probabilistic Graphical Models
- Support Vector Machines
- Gaussian Processes
- Unsupervised Learning (Clustering)
- Boosting
- Hidden Markov Models

Along with the lecture, there will be a lab course where practical examples are given, to which the algorithms discussed in the lecture can be applied.
prerequisites: The requirement for the class is basic knowledge in linear algebra and statistics, as well as good programming skills in C++.
